question: Who among the following was known for creating fusion arts by adapting European theatrical techniques to Indian Classical dance combined with Indian folk and tribal dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Uday Shankar is renowned for creating fusion arts by blending European theatrical techniques with Indian Classical dance forms.
 
• He also incorporated elements from Indian folk and tribal dance into his performances, creating a unique style.
 
• Uday Shankar's innovative approach helped popularize Indian dance on a global stage.
 
• He was a pioneer in modern dance in India and influenced many generations of dancers and choreographers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Classical Dance:**

 
 
• Indian Classical Dance refers to the traditional dance forms of India which have a rich cultural heritage and are deeply rooted in classical literature and mythology.
 
• Examples include Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, and Manipuri.
 
• These dances are characterized by intricate footwork, expressive hand gestures, and elaborate costumes.
 
 
 
• **Folk and Tribal Dance:**
 
 
• Folk and Tribal dances are performed by various communities in India and reflect the traditional lifestyle, culture, and beliefs of the people.
 
• These dances are usually performed during festivals, rituals, and celebrations and are an expression of joy and social togetherness.
 
• Each region of India has its own unique folk and tribal dances, such as Bhangra from Punjab, Garba from Gujarat, and Bihu from Assam.
 
 
 
• **European Theatrical Techniques:**
 
 
• These techniques refer to the methods and styles used in European theater, which include elements like stagecraft, lighting, set design, and dramatic storytelling.
 
• These techniques focus on enhancing the overall impact of the performance and creating a more immersive experience for the audience.
 
• Uday Shankar incorporated these techniques to add a new dimension to Indian dance performances, making them more visually and emotionally engaging.
